articles.title: Bitcoin extends bounce above $82,000 as stocks rebound, DeFi tokens lead altcoin gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rose 0.8% to around $82,700 as China’s GDP beat estimates and Nasdaq futures rebounded, while the CoinDesk 80 gained 1.3% and DeFi led gains.

articles.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
articles.snippet: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.

articles.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
articles.snippet: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.

articles.title: Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
articles.snippet: The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million.

articles.title: US Orders Civilian Agencies to Rip DeepSeek Out of Government Systems
articles.snippet: The Department of Homeland Security told civilian agencies to remove China's DeepSeek and any service built on it, and banned buying more, citing the risk of sensitive data reaching Beijing.
